# Title: the idea, in everyday words

One or two sentences: what the reader will understand by the end, and which Learn page
to read first if this one builds on it.

## The idea in plain words

The idea explained without its technical name, with an example the reader can hear or
try with their own voice. Name the term only after explaining it, and cite each factual
claim with its source number, like this [1].

## What it means for Wren

How Wren measures or uses the idea, and what it can't do. Say plainly where the science
is uncertain.

## Sources

1. Author, A. (Year). *Title*. Publisher. A link to a free copy or a catalogue record.
